programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: My Secret,Terrius Ep.3 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). She grows rapidly within the world of intelligence, which had seemed like a totally different world to her, and shows great performance that even surprises the NIS agents.

programme.title: Lucky Romance Ep.9
programme.desc: A romantic miniseries based on the web-toon of the safe title! Bo-nee, who wholeheartedly believes in superstitions, meets a man who believes in science and mathematics. She has to find a man born in the Year of the Tiger according to her fortuneteller, and soon after she gets entangled with a man who has never shown any interest in women or even dated one. This is a love story that follows an improbable couple that tries to reconcile their differing outlooks on life by overcoming superstitious beliefs and proving that destiny is not preordained.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.10
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.desc: Yi-gyeom takes Myung-yoon hostage to control Doseong. After hearing the truth from I-geon and Myung-yoon, Doseong pretends to comply—setting his own plan in motion.

programme.title: Missing Crown Prince Ep.1
programme.desc: A corpse is found inside the palace. As the Queen Dowager hides a dark secret, the Crown Prince is attacked by an assassin and faces grave danger.

programme.title: Missing Crown Prince Ep.2
programme.desc: Fearing her secret will be exposed, the Queen Dowager threatens Haejong. The Crown Prince confides in him—but that night, he is stabbed and collapses.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.19
programme.desc: Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.20
programme.desc: King Seonjo orders Gwanghae, Imhae, and Shinseong to find a way to end the people's widespread stomach illness, prompting Gwanghae to disguise himself and investigate in secret. While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.21
programme.desc: Despite Taedo's warnings that it is dangerous, Jeongi insists she must remain at the Bunwon to bring Gangcheon down from his nangcheong post. Reunited with Jeongi at the workshop, Gwanghae cannot hide his quiet delight. Meanwhile, Yukdo grows uneasy when he is forced to compete with Jeongi to create the lid for King Seonjo's cherished jar. He promises Jeongi that if she succeeds, he will elevate her to the rank of master potter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.22
programme.desc: When King Seonjo selects Yukdo's lid, Yukdo struggles to contain his joy, while Jeongi graciously acknowledges his skill. Gwanghae petitions the king to lift the Chief Scholar's exile, but Seonjo misinterprets the request as a threat to royal authority. programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey through the pristine waters of Raja Ampat. This Indonesian archipelago is home to some of the most beautiful and diverse marine life on the planet, including colorful fish and majestic Hawksbill Sea turtles. See the sheer beauty and vitality of this incredible ecosystem. From vibrant coral reefs and towering limestone cliffs to the dangerous ocean currents. A true celebration of nature's wonders and a powerful reminder of the importance of preserving our planet's delicate balance.

programme.title: Nature's Weirdest
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most – scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on. Each one finds its own way to exploit and conserve the available food and water in a daily struggle for survival.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Just north of New Zealand's biggest city, tens of thousands of fish school meters from the beach in one of the world's first marine reserves. Inside the Goat Island Reserve giant snapper can live for eighty years and crayfish grow to weigh 8 kilos. Both feed on the thousands of sea urchins that graze the kelp forest, maintaining a delicately balanced ecosystem. Like many of the reserve's inhabitants, they entrust their larvae to the ocean currents - so how do they find their way back to the reef when they take on their adult form and settle down?

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe's largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Coasts
programme.desc: A cat shark out hunting, guillemots fearlessly jumping from the cliffs of Helgoland, the birth of a snow-white baby seal: the 2,400km of German coastlines are home to a unique diversity of species. Over thousands of years, the slow current of the North Sea has allowed silt to accumulate and form the unique world of the Wadden Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2009. Nowhere else in the world does such a landscape exist that, thanks to the tides, is in a constant state of change. On the Baltic Sea, it's above all the Bodden that are unique. They form a chain of shallow bodies of water connected to the sea by narrow channels. Here in the brackish water, only specialists can survive. The North Sea coast is famed for its extensive mud flats, the Halligen islands which are often submerged in winter and endless sandy beaches and dykes. Seals sun themselves on sandbanks and regenerate after the rigours of hunting. Plum in the middle of the North Sea, the cliffs of Helgoland are a paradise for seabirds like gannets, black-legged kittiwakes and guillemots. For the grey seals, the mating season begins in winter and with it fearsome battles between rival males. The largest bulls weigh in at 300kg and are the biggest mammals in Germany. Hunted mercilessly by fishermen competing for the same fish, for many years the seals had disappeared from Germany's coasts. Now they're under protection and are slowly returning. North and Baltic Seas have retained their original character. The Baltic has Darss, Rügen and Usedom, three of the most beautiful holiday destinations in the country and with the whitest beaches. In autumn, red deer stags stamp majestically along the sand against the foamy backdrop of the Baltic. Peregrine falcons, too, have made coast and islands their home.

programme.desc: The Anavilhanas and Mariua archipelagos are deep in the heart of the Amazon rainforest. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We're here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you're in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they're going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they're all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let's see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We've got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan's Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We've got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They're going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other's strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let's find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world's strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we'll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We're in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.4
programme.desc: The Yoon Daehyeong faction schemes to place Bogyeong as the future queen of Gyotaejeon. Ahead of the royal selection of the Crown Princess, Hwon secretly expresses his wish for Yeonwoo to submit her maiden registration. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa's feelings for Yeom deepen, and she stubbornly demands that the king grant her permission to marry him.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.5
programme.desc: Yeonwoo remains at the royal villa, Eunwol Pavilion, devoting herself to rigorous court etiquette training. Unable to withstand the Queen Dowager Yoon's threats, Nokyoung casts a forbidden spell on Yeonwoo. Cast out of the palace and sent back to her family, Yeonwoo's illness steadily worsens. In secret, Nokyoung approaches Yeonwoo's father with a dangerous proposal.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.6
programme.desc: Trapped in terror inside a coffin, Yeonwoo is ultimately rescued by Nokyoung and returned to the world—only to awaken with all her memories erased. Taking Yeonwoo's place, Bogyeong ascends as Crown Princess. As Crown Prince Hwon comes of age, the kingdom's political situation grows ever more precarious under the schemes of powerful in-law families.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.7
programme.desc: Nokyoung repeatedly warns Yeonwoo to be wary of strangers. Defying Seol's pleas, Yeonwoo ventures into the streets, drawn by her desire to glimpse the king's royal procession. Catching sight of Hwon from afar, Yeonwoo is thrown into deep confusion.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.8
programme.desc: To use Nokyoung's spirit daughter Wol as a human talisman, she is abducted. As Wol attempts to escape, she receives help from Yangmyung—yet fails to recognize him. Dragged into the palace, Wol is forced to enter Hwon's bedchamber as a shaman meant to absorb misfortune.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.9
programme.desc: Upon awakening, Hwon fiercely interrogates Wol, demanding to know who sent her—yet finds himself strangely preoccupied with the shaman. Hearing of Wol's presence, Bogyeong instinctively senses an ominous threat closing in.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter YEGNY formerly known as Choi Ye-geun! This artist first became known in 2012 as the genius keyboardist in an audition program titled K-pop Star - Season 2. Since then she has actively pursued her career as a musician releasing a number of singles and working with other top-notch musicians including AKMU. Last year YEGNY released her first full-length album Even If Get Lost It Can Flow Anyway and shared with the public her concerns as a musician and self-reflection as well as her view on human relationships and social issues. With the song Better Rush (feat. Huckleberry P) she changed her stage name to YEGNY to mark a new beginning as an artist. In this episode YEGNY performs Better Rush I know Lucid dream and Unbalance as well as her cover of Better by BoA and Irony by Wonder Girls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out all that YEGNY has to show off!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter ARO! ARO burst into the music scene in July 2018 with the single A Good Daughter. Her stage name means engraving in Korean which conveys her hope to engrave her name in the minds of the public. She's also known for her ability to express common relatable issues in her own unique way deeply touching and soothing listeners' hearts. Sentimental at times yet unpredictable at others she's definitely engraving her name in our hearts. In this episode ARO performs SEESAW When The Night Comes Day 1 Why Did You Answer? and also her cover of Delispice's Confession. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: Against the Odds

programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn't let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds
programme.desc: This time on Against the Odds . . . the Special One, Jose Mourinho, who has managed many of the best clubs in football and won trophies wherever he's gone, and one of Manchester City's all-time greats, goalkeeper Bert Trautmann, and his courageous performance in the 1956 FA Cup Final.

programme.title: Against the Odds

programme.title: Against the Odds
programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds we salute two of the most mercurial footballers the game has even known, the era-defining Johan Cruyff and Brazil superstar Neymar.

programme.title: Against the Odds
programme.sub-title: S01:E30 - Leicester City FC, US Women's National Soccer Team, Iceland
programme.desc: Leicester City were almost relegated in their first year back in England's Premier League, the next year they won the entire competition. Megan Rapinoe and the US Women's National Soccer Team took on prominent social issues while taking on the world's best teams. Iceland were the smallest county to ever qualify for a major finals and ended up beating one of the giants of international football.

programme.title: Against the Odds
programme.sub-title: S01:E27 - Luka Modric, Lucy Bronze, George Best
programme.desc: Luka Modrić rose out of abject poverty during the Croatian War of Independence to become his nation's greatest player.Lucy Bronze emerged from the solitude of the Holy Island of Lindisfarne to become England's most decorated Lioness.And George Best grew up on the streets of troubled Belfast to become the footballer every Irishman loved.

programme.title: Against the Odds
programme.sub-title: S01:E32 - Billie Jean King, Arthur Ashe, Kim Clijsters
programme.desc: Billie Jean King battled the establishment to elevate the women's game to new heights, Arthur Ashe overcame racism and a compromised heart to fight for positive change across a broad spectrum of causes, and Kim Clijsters came back from the physical rigours of childbirth to become the most successful tennis mother in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds
programme.sub-title: S01:E13 - Christiano Ronaldo, Zinedine Zidane, Eusebio
programme.desc: In this episode of Against the Odds, we look at the brilliant career of Ronaldo, perhaps the only Brazilian footballer to rival Pele we examine Zinedine Zidane as a player and a manager who reached the top in both fields and we pay tribute to 1960s legend Eusebio.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage
programme.sub-title: S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn't cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football's greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage

German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football's Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage
programme.sub-title: S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain's Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there's the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There's much to discuss on Football's Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage
programme.desc: A World Cup hero for West Germany, Franz Beckenbauer is enshrined in his country's football folklore. A captain turned coach, Dunga inspired Brazil to glory in 1994, but came up heartbreakingly short in 2014. And Gordon Banks - who kept it clean for England on the way to greatness in 1966. That's this week, on Football's Greatest Stage

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Il corsaro nero
programme.desc: Il capitano Black un pirata coraggioso e affascinante, alla guida della sua ciurma decide di assaltare la nave che porta l`oro dalle colonie spagnole alla madrepatria. Quando scopre che la nave non trasporta oro, ma la moglie del viceré della colonia, Black decide di rapirla per chiedere l`oro in riscatto. Anche Skull vuole l`oro, si allea così con altri pirati nemici di Black per sottrargli la donna..

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: Il fotografo ventiseienne Dennis Stock è molto più maturo dei suoi anni e ancora legato alla vita familiare quando nel 1955 riceve il compito di fotografare per il magazine Life l'astro nascente James Dean, uno spirito libero destinato a divenire un idolo e a cambiare per sempre la cultura popolare. L'assegnazione del servizio porterà Dennis e James ad affrontare un viaggio per gli States, che plasmerà Stock e consegnerà alla storia alcune delle immagini più iconiche del periodo.

programme.title: Cacciatore di teste
programme.desc: Bruno Davert è un manager del settore della carta di mezza età che ha perso il lavoro a causa di una ristrutturazione e delocalizzazione della sua azienda. Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali concorrenti, altri manager che come lui hanno perso il posto e vivono di espedienti partecipando ad umilianti colloqui di lavoro.

programme.title: Foxcatcher
programme.desc: Medaglie d'oro olimpiche nel 1984, Mark e Dave Schultz si preparano a difendere il titolo ai prossimi Giochi di Seoul. Tuttavia, Mark viene escluso dal gruppo degli atleti selezionati, proprio come suo fratello maggiore, e si sforza di allenarsi da solo. Mark ritrova la speranza quando il filantropo e miliardario John du Pont, intenzionato a mettere insieme la migliore squadra di wrestling in tutto il mondogli gli chiede di aderire al marchio wrestling di un nuovo club. Ma le illusioni paranoiche di Du Pont e la sua irrazionale volontà di garantire la vittoria degli Stati Uniti all'estero avranno la precedenza sulla sua generosità e gentilezza. Il film è tratto da una storia vera: nel 1996 John du Pont, affetto da schizofrenia paranoide, uccise l'amico David Schultz, campione olimpico di wrestling.

programme.title: The Door
programme.desc: In Ungheria, negli anni Sessanta, dopo anni di censura, la scrittrice Magda riesce ad ottenere il giusto riconoscimento per le sue opere letterarie, apprestandosi a conoscere il suo successo. Insieme al marito, decide di assumere una cameriera e la sua scelta ricade su Emerenc, una donna vitale e buona ma moralmente rigida e intransigente, che non ha mai permesso a nessuno di oltrepassare la porta di casa sua, chiusa a chiunque. Con il passare del tempo, tra le due donne si crea un forte rapporto di odio e amore reciproco che porta Emerenc a rivelare il segreto più grande della sua vita e il tragico passato che si porta sulle spalle.

programme.title: Il Natale di Belle
programme.desc: È quasi Natale e Belle si trova a dover lasciare la California per un lavoro: la casa d'aste per cui lavora la manda nella villa di un cliente, Hunter Lowell, che sembrerebbe essere tutto fuorché amichevole. Belle lavora sodo: la magione è stupenda, il cliente un po' meno. Quando, però, i due cominciano a spendere più tempo assieme scocca la scintilla. Basterà questo a scaldare il suo cuore di ghiaccio?

programme.title: NATALE A HAPPY HOLLOW
programme.desc: I piani di una promotrice immobiliare incontrano un ostacolo quando scopre che ci sono molti proprietari di una fattoria di alberi di Natale che ha recentemente acquistato. Per salvare il suo progetto, deve collaborare con uno storico locale per convincere i proprietari a vendere le loro quote di terreno.

programme.title: CHRISTMAS DANCE
programme.desc: Il Natale non è decisamente il periodo preferito per Sarah. Quando si rirova a tornare a casa per un'emergenza inaspettata, volti del passato faranno un piacevole ritorno nella sua vita

programme.title: Un Natale Inaspettato
programme.desc: Theodora torna nella sua città d'origine per Natale ma per lavoro. Si ritroverà a scontrarsi con Charlie, scrittore, che conquisterà piano piano il suo cuore

programme.title: LAssassinio Di Un Allibratore Cinese
programme.desc: Cosmo Vittelli, titolare di uno squallido cabaret, perde una enorme cifra al gioco, indebitandosi con il criminale Mort. Quest'ultimo gli offre la possibilità di ripagare il proprio debito eliminando un fastidioso allibratore protetto dalla mafia.

programme.title: Guerra al virus
programme.desc: America anni '80. Il dottor Francis è uno dei primi a scoprire il virus dell'Hiv, ma la società americana rimane indifferente alla malattia considerandola pericolosa solo per gli omosessuali.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e la...Malafemmina
programme.desc: I fratelli Capone sono diametralmente opposti. Peppino lavoratore e risparmiatore, Antonio sfaticato e scialacquone. Devono però unirsi per riportare il nipote, studente di medicina a Napoli, sulla retta via.

programme.title: Please Stand By: Tutto ciò che voglio
programme.desc: Wendy soffre di una forma di autismo, che la cura e la struttura specializzata di Scottie riescono a tenere sotto controllo, favorendo una rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva di Star Trek.

programme.title: Il Fidanzato Di Mia Sorella
programme.desc: Un carismatico professore di poesia di Cambridge, che vive a Los Angeles, vede la sua vita spensierata stravolta quando una studentessa con cui ha una relazione rimane incinta.

programme.title: Dylan Dog
programme.desc: Deciso a lasciare mostri e non morti al loro mondo, l'indagatore dell'incubo Dylan Dog viene richiamato suo malgrado in servizio dalla bionda Elizabeth, per far luce sulla misteriosa morte di suo padre.

programme.title: Giovani ribelli
programme.desc: La vera storia mai raccontata di quattro giovani studenti della Columbia University che ispirati dall'esempio di Walt Whitman e della "setta dei poeti estinti" sfidarono le rigide regole della più potente Università Americana.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: Quando l'agente dell'FBI Roy Clayton dirige le indagini riguardanti una pericolosa cospirazione internazionale, tutti gli indizi sembrano ricondurre all'ex ufficiale delle operazioni speciali americane Samir Horn.

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: Hard night falling
programme.desc: Durante una cena nella lussuosa villa della famiglia Rossini, il criminale Goro e la sua banda prendono in ostaggio gli invitati per rubare un'ingente quantità d'oro. Ignorano però che tra gli ospiti c'è Michael Anderson (Dolph Lundgren), un agente dell'Interpol altamente addestrato, determinato a salvare la sua famiglia e sventare il colpo.

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: Un mattatoio di Welch è lo scenario di una serie di eventi misteriosi che colpiscono una giovane famiglia perseguitata dal fantasma arrabbiato di un bambino morto proprio lì anni prima.

programme.title: Ricetta mortale
programme.desc: Ivy e Skyler hanno aperto un popolare sito web. La salute di Ivy risente dello stress. Il suo medico la fa scansionare. Le resta solo poco tempo da vivere. Comincia con farmaci costosi, illegali e sperimentali. Il dottore sta mentendo?

programme.title: Indiavolato
programme.desc: Il disperato nerd Elliot Richards riceve sette desideri dal Diavolo per conquistare Allison, la ragazza dei suoi sogni, in cambio della sua anima.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: L'astronauta Roy McBride arriva ai margini esterni del sistema solare per trovare il padre scomparso e risolvere un mistero che minaccia la sopravvivenza del nostro pianeta.

programme.title: L'uomo del mistero
programme.desc: Abby Morel è una giovane e brillante assistente di redazione che vive in una grande città. Desiderosa di fare carriera, stringe un insolito accordo con il suo ambizioso capo: Susan. Susan è troppo impegnata per uscire con qualcuno, ma vuole innamorarsi. Abby accetta di 'passare al vaglio' gli appuntamenti di Susan in cambio di una promozione. A rendere le cose più complicate c'è cheSusan è alla ricerca dell'uomo perfetto! Dopo un paio diappuntamenti disastrosi, Abby incontra Dan, che sembra avere tutte le carte in regola. Il problema è che anche Abby lei comincia a innamorarsi di lui... Con Una promettente carriera ormai a portata di mano, Abby deciderà di mettere tutto a rischio per il vero amore?

programme.title: Love on Harbor island
programme.desc: Lily è una giovane interior designer che abita a Seattle, ma è nata e cresciuta in un piccolo paese, dove sua zia Maggie gestisce un b&b. Avendo bisogno d'aiuto, Maggie chiama la nipote per aiutarla a gestire l'azienda. Lì incontra l'affascinante Marcus.

programme.title: Maschile Singolare
programme.desc: Antonio è costretto a mettere in discussione tutte le proprie certezze quando viene abbandonato dal marito, dal quale dipende sia psicologicamente che economicamente. Deve quindi trovare una nuova casa, un lavoro e un nuovo scopo nella vita.

programme.title: Il Fidanzato Di Mia Sorella
programme.desc: Un carismatico professore di poesia di Cambridge, che vive a Los Angeles, vede la sua vita spensierata stravolta quando una studentessa con cui ha una relazione rimane incinta.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Quando Joel (Paul Rudd) e Molly (Amy Poehler) si incontrano, è odio a prima vista: la grande azienda produttrice di dolciumi di lui minaccia di far chiudere la piccola impresa indipendente di lei.

programme.title: La donna del tenente francese
programme.desc: Candidato a cinque premi Oscar (tra cui quello alla migliore attrice per Meryl Streep), questo capolavoro vanta nel suo cast anche Jeremy Irons, in una delle storie d'amore di più forte impatto visivo mai portate sullo schermo.

programme.title: W.
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar Oliver Stone tratteggia la dissacrante biografia dell'uomo più potente del mondo per ben otto anni: George W. Bush, amato e odiato, una delle figure più controverse della storia americana dei nostri tempi.

programme.title: Till
programme.desc: "Till - la giustizia di una madre" è un film molto toccante sulla vera storia dell'incessante ricerca della giustizia da parte di Mamie Till-Mobley, il cui figlio di 14 anni, Emmett Till, in visita ai cugini in Mississippi, fu linciato nel 1955.

programme.title: The Secret Reunion
programme.desc: Un agente segreto nordcoreano e un agente sudcoreano un tempo rivali e ormai in congedo, si ritrovano a dover lavorare gomito a gomito in un'agenzia investigativa.

programme.title: Unestate a Firenze
programme.desc: L'incontro tra un giocatore di football americano e una ragazza in visita alla cugina. Un amore che nasce sullo sfondo di Firenze.

programme.title: Una corona per due
programme.desc: Quando il fidanzato di Riley, Mandla, la invita in Sudafrica per conoscere la sua famiglia, lei rimane scioccata nello scoprire che lui è un principe. La notizia mette in pericolo la fiducia di Riley in Mandla.

programme.title: Sempre Natale
programme.desc: BASATO SUL LIBRO DI RUTH CLAMPETT. Quando la produttrice di reality show maniaca del lavoro Sophie inizia a lavorare a uno spettacolo natalizio su Will, un ragazzo straordinariamente bello che celebra il Natale tutti i giorni dell'anno, si ritrova a innamorarsi della sua misteriosa, improbabile nuova stella, rinnovando la sua fede nel Natale perduta da tempo. nel processo.

programme.title: Amore alla moda
programme.desc: Quando una fashionista cambia il suo numero di telefono, riceve messaggi dall'ex della donna che in precedenza possedeva quel numero. Il suo nuovo numero è stato l'inizio di una storia d'amore?

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Alice Harvey, ventinovenne assistente editor e aspirante scrittrice, è divertente, intelligente ed emotivamente autodistruttiva. Scalando le fila di una importante casa editrice, si sforza di scrivere la propria storia da sempre ostacolata dai ricordi della sua relazione giovanile con Milan, il miglior amico di suo padre. Dopo 15 anni, i percorsi di Alice e Milan si incrociano ancora una volta, costringendo i due a confrontarsi con eventi che sono ormai lontani.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler e suo marito Greg stanno cercando di trovare la scuola elementare giusta per il loro figlio di 4 anni, Jake. Descritto come gender-expansive dal suo consulente, il comportamento sempre più irregolare di Jake inizia a causare una spaccatura tra la coppia. Alex teme che gli adulti della sua vita lo stiano etichettando prematuramente, mentre Greg si chiede se la passione di Jake per i travestimenti non sia solo una fase.

programme.title: Lo scafandro e la farfalla
programme.desc: L'8 dicembre 1995, Jean-Dominique Bauby - giornalista e padre di due figli - cade improvvisamente in coma. Quando si sveglia è immobilizzato, colpito da quella che la medicina definisce "sindrome locked-in": riesce a muovere solo la palpebra sinistra, che diventa il suo legame con il mondo...

programme.title: La Regina degli scacchi
programme.desc: Maria Adele, 17 anni, vive per gli scacchi, ma scopre di essere stata adottata e, con l'aiuto di un giornalista, rintraccia la madre biologica. Mentre riaffiora un ricordo d'infanzia che la libera dai tormenti, emerge un'indagine che svela crimini del suo maestro di scacchi, culminati in un tragico epilogo.

programme.title: Rams
programme.desc: In una valle islandese isolata, Gummi e Kiddiley vivono fianco a fianco, badando al gregge di famiglia, considerato uno dei migliori del paese. I due fratelli vengono spesso premiati per le loro preziose pecore appartenenti a un ceppo antichissimo. Benché dividano la terra e conducano la stessa vita, Gummi e Kiddi non si parlano da quarant'anni. Quando una malattia letale colpisce il gregge di Kiddi, minacciando l'intera vallata, le autorità decidono di abbattere tutti gli animali della zona per contenere l'epidemia.

programme.title: Rosso Mille Miglia
programme.desc: Una giornalista insaziabile, un meccanico passionale, un barista inconsapevole si trovano insieme per la celebre Mille Miglia, sulla quale Maria, interpretata da Martina Stella, deve scrivere un pezzo per conto di un giornale tedesco. È l'inizio di una misteriosa avventura in cui i tre riusciranno a cucire i pezzi di una storia destinata a riportare in auge un gioiello automobilistico, il cui destino era quello di brillare. Si tratta della favolosa OM 665 S, che Maria e il meccanico Marco, a cui da volto Fabio Troiano, sperano di poter rimontare per iscriversi alla corsa "più bella del mondo". I due, andando a ritroso nel tempo si imbatteranno in un segreto ormai sepolto che farà emergere un passato tenuto nascosto.

programme.title: Un divano a tunisi
programme.desc: Selma, giovane psicanalista, torna a Tunisi all'indomani della Primavera araba, decisa ad aprire uno studio privato si scontrerà con un ambiente sfavorevole.

programme.title: Parlami Di Te
programme.desc: Alain è un uomo d'affari che non concede alcuno spazio alle distrazioni e alla famiglia. Viene colpito da un ictus, che gli lascia una grave difficoltà nell'espressione verbale e una perdita della memoria. Si affida a una giovane logopedista.

programme.title: Ladre per caso
programme.desc: L'introversa Carole e la ribelle Caroline hanno in comune solo il padre Patrick, un ladro internazionale ricercato ovunque. Intenzionato a rubare uno «stradivari», Patrick chiederà aiuto alle due figlie, tentando di recuperare il tempo perduto.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: Quando lo stregone cattivo Gargamella insegue i piccoli puffi blu fuori dal loro villaggio, dal loro mondo magico cadono nel nostro, trovandosi nel bel mezzo di Central Park a New York. I Puffi dovranno trovare il modo di ritornare al loro villaggio prima che Gargamella li catturi.

programme.title: I Puffi 2
programme.desc: Lo stregone Gargamella crea i Monelli, delle creature furbe simili ai Puffi,per impadronirsi dell'essenza magica dei Puffi. Gargamella scopre di aver bisogno dell'aiuto di Puffetta, l'unica che sa trasformare i Monelli in Puffi. Quando Gargamella e i Monelli rapiscono Puffetta dal villaggio dei Puffi e la portano a Parigi, toccherà al Grande Puffo, Tontolone, Brontolone e Vanitoso salvare Puffetta con l'aiuto dei loro amici umani Patrick e Grace Winslow!

programme.title: I Puffi: Viaggio Nella Foresta Segreta
programme.desc: In questa nuova avventura animata dei Puffi, una mappa misteriosa conduce Puffetta e i suoi migliori amici Quattrocchi, Tontolone e Forzuto a una corsa elettrizzante nella Foresta Segreta piena di creature magiche per trovare un misterioso villaggio perduto prima che ci riesca il malvagio mago Gargamella. In una rocambolesca avventura piena d'azione e pericoli, i Puffi affrontano una missione che porterà alla scoperta di uno dei più grandi segreti nella storia dei Puffi!

programme.title: You Don't Mess With The Zohan
programme.desc: Il protagonista di questa commedia è Zohan, un soldato israeliano che finge di essere morto per realizzare il suo sogno: fare il parrucchiere a New York.

programme.title: Quando la coppia scoppia
programme.desc: Enrico, caricaturista trentenne, affronta il divorzio, la gelosia e trova una nuova compagna di vita

programme.title: Il ras del quartiere
programme.desc: Domingo, capo di teppisti e custodi del quartiere, aiuta un uomo a cercare la figlia scappata di casa

programme.title: Il magnate
programme.desc: Clara, moglie di Furio Cicerone, rifiuta il conte Arienti, ma intrighi finanziari mettono tutto a rischio

programme.title: I baroni
programme.desc: Leopoldo, impotente prima delle nozze, guarisce grazie a una danese, ma deve sposare Mariantonia per ereditare.

programme.title: Il casinista
programme.desc: Il comico Marullo spinge l'amico Casciotta a scrivere storie reali, scatenando una serie di disavventure.

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Le vite di diversi personaggi si intrecciano in un susseguirsi di difficoltà quotidiane e situazioni comiche. Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida e Marcello Mastroianni sono protagonisti di una commedia che racconta le piccole disavventure della vita, con ironia e causticità.

programme.title: L'Uomo Che Sapeva Troppo Poco
programme.desc: Bill Murray è un americano imbranato che, mentre è in vacanza a Londra in visita al fratello, partecipa a un programma di 'virtual reality'. Quando crede che un vero tentativo di assassinio faccia parte del gioco, si trova per sbaglio immischiato in un caso di scambio d'identità e omicidio.

programme.title: Boo! A Madea Halloween
programme.desc: Nella più paurosa notte dell'anno, Madea è chiamata a tenere d'occhio la figlia adolescente di Brian e fare in modo che non si cacci nei guai.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Uno sfortunato gruppo di orfani provenienti da ambienti curiosi si riunisce per imbarcarsi in un'avventura che li porta in una speciale fabbrica di cioccolato dove cadono in un armadio incantato e finiscono in una terra magica.

programme.title: La coppia dei campioni
programme.desc: Due dipendenti della stessa multinazionale vincono alla lotteria aziendale un paio di biglietti per la finale della Champions League. Uno milanese, l'altro romano, uno benestante e l'altro nullatenente si conoscono per la prima volta all'imbarco per Praga detestandosi a prima vista.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Un incauto fattorino consegna inavvertitamente all'indirizzo sbagliato un pacco contenente panetti di cocaina occultati.

programme.title: Interstate 60
programme.desc: Dal creatore di Ritorno al Futuro. Neil è un pittore ostacolato dal padre che vorrebbe vederlo laureato in legge. La situazione cambia all'improvviso quando incontra One Wish Grant (premio Oscar Gary Oldman), uomo in grado di esaudire ogni desiderio.

programme.title: La casa dei sogni
programme.desc: Una coppia cerca la casa perfetta in cui andare a vivere e decide di assumere un architetto. L'uomo, invece di svolgere il lavoro per il quale era stato assunto, progetta la dimora dei propri sogni.

programme.title: Company Man
programme.desc: Per evitare la moglie petulante, un insegnante si finge agente segreto della CIA e viene reclutato per rovesciare la dittatura di Fidel Castro a Cuba.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e lavorano nella redazione di un giornale satirico. Dado ha successo con le donne mentre Marco ha molti problemi, fin quando non arrivano Adele e Maria a cambiare le loro vite.

programme.title: I due pezzi da 90
programme.desc: Franco e Ciccio sono costretti ad abbandonare il loro salumificio per raggiungere il padrino di Franco: Nico Cavallaro. I due non sanno che costui è un contrabbandiere di droga e che vuole servirsi di loro per trasportare la merce.

programme.title: Barabba
programme.desc: Liberato al posto di Gesù, il brigante Barabba vive tormentato dal dubbio su chi fosse davvero l'uomo condannato alla croce.

programme.title: Solo contro Roma
programme.desc: Il console romano, dopo aver conquistato la città di Alesia, lascia a governare un suo Tribuno. Perfido e crudele, quest'ultimo commette a ogni tipo di nefandezze, arrivando a far arrestare il capo della città e sua figlia, Fabiola. Quando Brenno, il fidanzato di Fabiola viene condannato a morte, la città di Alesia si ribella.

programme.title: Erode il grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Maciste contro i cacciatori di teste
programme.desc: In terre selvagge e misteriose, Maciste sfida tribù feroci e pericoli mortali per salvare innocenti e ristabilire la pace.

programme.title: Il venditore di morte
programme.desc: Il pistolero Silver viene assunto da un avvocato per dimostrare che il suo cliente, Chester Conway, è innocente della rapina al saloon per cui è stato condannato all'impiccagione.

programme.title: El Cjorro
programme.desc: Alla fine del 1800, un capitano dell'esercito tenta di domare le pianure argentine, popolate da indiani e banditi. Per sostenere i suoi uomini, porta con sé un gruppo di donne incaricate di intrattenerli, in un contesto di conflitti e sopravvivenza.

programme.title: La strage del 7º
programme.desc: Il capo Toro Seduto della tribù dei Sioux è costretto dal generale Custer, che odia gli indiani, a reagire con la violenza, dando luogo alla famosa “Ultima posizione” a Little Bighorn. Parrish, amico dei Sioux, cerca di impedire lo spargimento di sangue, ma viene deferito alla corte marziale per “collaborazione” con il nemico. Toro Seduto, tuttavia, riesce a intercedere presso il presidente Grant a favore di Parrish.

programme.title: Il giustiziere di Dio

programme.title: La zona morta (The dead zone)

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: L'astronauta Roy McBride (Brad Pitt) viaggia fino ai lontani confini del sistema solare per trovare il padre scomparso e dipanare un mistero che minaccia la sopravvivenza del nostro pianeta.

programme.title: Storie di fantasmi cinesi III
programme.desc: Dopo un prologo tratto dal primo episodio, la vicenda si focalizza su una coppia di monaci, il giovane Fong e il suo anziano maestro, in viaggio attraverso la campagna con un'immagine di Buddha. I loro guai cominceranno durante una sosta notturna in un tempio abitato dagli spettri.

programme.title: Il Gioco Dell'inganno

programme.title: The Monster And The Ape
programme.desc: When a robot dubbed Metalogen Man is stolen by a giant ape, its creator goes on an epic quest to find it and the party responsible for its abduction.

programme.title: Trappola Cinese
programme.desc: Paul Konan è un fotografo tedesco che, in Cina per realizzare un servizio sulla popolazione locale, si innamora dell'affascinante guida Liyun. La donna poco dopo viene rapita dalla Triade, la mafia locale, e l'uomo, tornato in Germania, inizia a subire pesanti ricatti dall'organizzazione criminale ed è costretto a sottostarvi per salvare Liyun.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: Una base lunare viene colpita da una pioggia di meteoriti che porta con sé spore aliene. Isolati e senza possibilità di fuga, gli astronauti scoprono che l'organismo può assumere forma umana. Paranoia e paura dilagano mentre l'equipaggio cerca di impedire che la minaccia raggiunga la Terra.

programme.title: Tides
programme.desc: In un futuro in cui la Terra è stata devastata e quasi sommersa, un'astronauta torna sul pianeta per scoprire se può essere nuovamente abitato. Rimasta sola tra comunità di sopravvissuti e lotte per il controllo delle risorse, dovrà prendere una decisione da cui dipende il futuro dell'umanità.

programme.title: Alien Expedition

Ma la missione scientifica si trasforma presto in una lotta per la sopravvivenza quando l'equipaggio scopre forme di vita aliene estremamente aggressive.

programme.title: Alien Origin

Tra giungla, rovine e segnali inspiegabili, la squadra si avvicina alla verità sull'origine della vita sulla Terra e a una presenza extraterrestre che non avrebbe mai dovuto incontrare.

programme.title: Stonehenge Apocalypse

Rimasti soli, in mezzo a una strada deserta e in piena notte, vedono sfumare davanti ai loro occhi ogni possibile tentativo di fuga e le loro possibilità di sopravvivenza diminuiscono sempre di più.

Deciso a catturare le loro anime per farle finalmente riposare in pace, mette insieme una squadra di cacciatori di fantasmi. Una volta entrati nella casa del killer, più il gruppo scende in profondità, più i fantasmi diventano ostili, fino a scoprire una sconvolgente verità.

Nelle acque profonde, Marina dovrà lottare contro il mostro del lago per salvare il suo fidanzato Roman e non essere trasformata in un demone.

Inseguito dalla polizia, Nicola si sposta tra Napoli, Roma, Caserta e Palermo e incontra Claudia, boss emergente della mafia…

Approda nella Repubblica Dominicana durante il governo dittatoriale di Trujillo, sulle cui terribili verità scrive un libro coraggioso.
